description: It lists the outgoing webhooks of the whole install: id, name, trigger, delivery address, mirror address, method, format, whether it is active, and how many rules it carries. These fire for every webinar on the install, not only for the one open in the chat. Take it when a host asks which connections are wired up. "Where does my data actually go?" It needs nothing but the site. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webhook, outgoing, trigger, integrations

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.
